scope: 2010 asynchronous zero-delay paint scheduling and diagnostic observation. No simulation arithmetic, tick duration, frame advance or positive paint delay changes.
checks: One MessageChannel is created and its callback is the hoisted paint function. Posting remains asynchronous; state.pending deduplicates both immediate and timed requests.
Positive delays retain the prior setTimeout route. Missing MessageChannel uses the original zero-delay timer fallback.
Ready/closed/error/modal request gating and nextPaint behavior are unchanged; a pending paint clears pending before its existing modal/closed/error early return.
The instrumentation intercepts the actual onmessage setter and wraps only callbacks named paint. Other message handlers remain uncounted, and timer measurement retains its original argument delivery.
